description: Request for a single user change access to a resource.

type.description: The type of access change for this user. Users can gain access, renew access, or have access revoked.
type.name: AccessType

enum.name: GAIN_ACCESS
enum.description: Grant access to the user for the specified resource.

enum.name: RENEW_ACCESS
enum.description: Renew the user's access to the specified resource.

enum.name: REVOKE_ACCESS
enum.description: Revoke the user's access to the specified resource.
